csv_project_name: DB for Light Rail Modernization LRMP(Tranche 3)
csv_scope_of_work: The Design-Build Contract includes design and construction of improvements ( the Project ) at the Cromwell Maintenance and Storage Facility (henceforth referred to as Cromwell MSF or Cromwell ) located at 7390 Baltimore Annapolis Blvd, Glen Burnie, MD to accommodate the anticipated purchase of new Low Floor Light Rail Vehicles (LFLRVs), the transition from the current High Floor Light Rail Vehicle (HFLRV) fleet to new LFLRVs, and the transitioning, training, testing, commissioning, and maintenance activities for the new LFLRVs.

title: Design-Build for Light Rail Modernization LRMP (Tranche 3)
short_description: Design-build modernization of a light rail maintenance and storage facility in Glen Burnie.
project_location: Cromwell Maintenance and Storage Facility, 7390 Baltimore Annapolis Blvd, Glen Burnie, Maryland, USA
project_scope: Design and construction improvements at the Cromwell Maintenance and Storage Facility to accommodate new low-floor light rail vehicles, replace the current high-floor fleet, and support transition, training, testing, commissioning, and maintenance activities.
services: Design-build services for facility improvements; all disciplines requested.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is a transit maintenance and storage facility modernization, not a bridge, stadium, long-span roof, tower, or special structure.
- Classified as a general building/facility project with no indication of architecturally demanding or structurally innovative scope.
- Includes design-build planning component, but the available notice provides no structural complexity or special engineering features relevant to sbp.
- Rail-related project concerns facility modernization rather than railway bridge structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: design-build improvements at an existing maintenance and storage facility for new low-floor light rail vehicles, including transition, training, testing, commissioning, and maintenance support. No area, quantities, or technical parameters are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source, and the notice does not provide enough scope detail for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. No specific reference or qualification requirements are stated in the source excerpt.
